codeConduite.intro: These rules protect students, and they protect you. Read them, then accept.
regles: Your classes are held in the academy's room. A class may be audio-recorded, and a person in charge of review may follow it live without telling you when. A parent may also attend the class for a limited time, to see how the session goes: you are informed. You accept these measures: they protect children and they protect you.
You see your students' first names. Their full name is not shown, to keep the screen short. You never see a family's contact details: no email, no phone.
What you know about a child stays with the academy, to protect their personal data. You do not make it public and you do not show it to other families.
You never contact a student or their family privately, outside the app.
In front of the camera, your dress is appropriate and the background behind you is neutral and calm.
You are on time. You open the room before the class starts.
You are also callers to the faith: be exemplary in your words and gestures, and patient with each student.
If a child's safety worries you, report it right away with "Report a need", category "A child's safety". The management reads it first.
If you refuse these rules, the academy cannot entrust students to you, because they protect children.

p1.intro: Before the questions, here is what you need to know about us.

academie.texte: Rewayah Academy teaches the Quran remotely, in stable classes, with a dedicated teacher. It has been teaching since 1 May 2024.

liberte.texte: As long as you are not a teacher, you can withdraw your application from your file.

donnees.texte: Your answers are only read by the people at the academy who review your application.

separation.texte: A woman's application is followed by the management on the women's side, a man's application on the men's side.

p2.intro: You teach by video, in a class that stays the same.

classe.texte: You keep the same class over time, with the same students.

horaires.texte: Your class meets on the same days and at the same times, three times a week.

visio.texte: Classes are given by video conference, in the Rewayah app.

remuneration.texte: Your pay is a share of the price each student present pays. It is explained to you as a percentage before you send your application.

examen.texte: You answer the questions, read and accept our agreements, upload your photo and your ID document, then send your application. The management reads it.

entretien.titre: Let's get to know each other
entretien.texte: If your application is accepted, you choose a slot and the management meets you by video, in the app.

verification.texte: When everything is in order, you join the academy's team of teachers, in the app.

moinsDeTrois(param=n).one: You chose a single day. A class meets three times a week, on the same days: consider choosing at least three.
moinsDeTrois(param=n).other: You chose {n} days. A class meets three times a week, on the same days: consider choosing at least three.

creneaux.troisSeances: A class meets three times a week, on the same days and at the same time.
creneaux.durees: A children's class lasts {enfants}, an adults' class lasts {adultes}.

versement.virementSeul: In your country, the academy has confirmed bank transfer. No mobile payment method is offered for now.
versement.aucunMoyen: Rewayah does not yet pay teachers in this country. You can send your application: it will stay on hold until a method becomes possible.
versement.chargement: We are looking for the methods possible in your country.
versement.nonCharge: The payment methods for your country could not be loaded.
versement.operateurExplication: You declare it now. Your details are only requested before your first payment.

recap.explication: Tap an answer to change it. Nothing is sent before the "Send my application" button.

langueMaternelle.explication: It is the language you have spoken since childhood. This question is optional: you can continue without answering.

languesExplication.titre: In which languages can you explain and correct?
languesExplication.explication: Choose all the languages in which you can explain a rule to a student and correct their mistakes, with no limit on the number. The student or their parent chooses their language at sign-up, and the academy assigns them a teacher who speaks it: the more you speak, the more you can teach. Arabic is not a class language: it is not in this list.

niveauMemorisationDeclare.titre: How much of the Quran have you memorised?
niveauMemorisationDeclare.explication: You declare it here. Having memorised and having an ijaza are two different things: the ijaza is asked a little further on.

aucune.libelle: I have not memorised a whole juz
aucune.description: You may know a few surahs, but not a whole juz.
aucune.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
aucune.exemple: you recite a few short surahs from memory, but not a whole juz.

moins_10_juz.libelle: I have memorised fewer than 10 juz
moins_10_juz.description: From one whole juz to nine juz, out of the thirty of the Quran.
moins_10_juz.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
moins_10_juz.exemple: you have memorised five juz out of thirty.

de_10_a_29_juz.description: From a third of the Quran to almost all of it.
de_10_a_29_juz.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
de_10_a_29_juz.exemple: you have memorised twenty juz out of thirty.

coran_entier.libelle: I have memorised the whole Quran
coran_entier.description: All 114 surahs, from the first to the last, by heart.
coran_entier.explication: This level is assessed during the interview.
coran_entier.exemple: you recite Al-Baqara, then An-Nas, without opening the book.

niveauLectureTajwid.titre: How do you read the Quran?
niveauLectureTajwid.explication: Tajwid is the set of rules that say how to pronounce each letter of the Quran.

lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.libelle: I read without applying the tajwid rules
lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.description: You read fluently, without following the pronunciation rules.
lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.explication: Your reading is assessed during the interview.
lecture_sans_regles_tajwid.exemple: you read a page without hesitating, but you do not apply the tajwid rules.

tajwid_applique.libelle: I apply the tajwid rules when reading
tajwid_applique.description: You follow the pronunciation rules when you read.
tajwid_applique.explication: Your reading is assessed during the interview.
tajwid_applique.exemple: you lengthen and pronounce letters as the tajwid rules require.

tajwid_enseigne.libelle: I apply tajwid and I can teach it
tajwid_enseigne.description: You follow the rules and can explain them to a student.
tajwid_enseigne.explication: Your reading is assessed during the interview.
tajwid_enseigne.exemple: when a student makes a mistake on a letter, you explain the rule and they repeat it.

riwayat.explication: A riwaya is a transmitted way of reciting the Quran. Choose all those you recite.

ishaq.description: Transmitted from Khalaf, the tenth reciter

idris.description: Transmitted from Khalaf, the tenth reciter

ijazaPresentable.explication: An ijaza is a written authorisation, given by a teacher, to transmit the Quran. Whoever has an ijaza has memorised, but whoever has memorised does not necessarily have an ijaza: it is a separate question.

oui.libelle: Yes, I have an ijaza to present
oui.description: You can show it by video.
oui.explication: It is shown during the interview: you have nothing to send now.
oui.exemple: a document signed by your teacher, which you keep at home.

pret_test.libelle: No ijaza, but I can take a test
pret_test.description: You have no ijaza to present, but you agree to take a test.
pret_test.explication: The academy will discuss it with you during the interview.
pret_test.exemple: you learned with a teacher without a written document, and you agree to be tested.

non.libelle: No, I do not have an ijaza
non.description: You have no ijaza, and you do not plan to take a test for now.
non.explication: Your level is then assessed during the interview.
non.exemple: you learned with a teacher, without receiving a written document.

experienceDebutants.explication: A beginner is still learning to read the letters and join them.

oui.libelle: Yes, I have already taught beginners
oui.description: You have already guided students who are just starting.
oui.explication: The management knows before the interview.
oui.exemple: you taught the Arabic letters to children or to adults.

non.description: You have not yet taught beginners.
non.explication: You can still send your application.
non.exemple: you have only taught students who already knew how to read.

fuseauIana.explication: Your availability is in your local time. So the time must be right.

disponibilitesDeclarees.explication: A class meets three times a week, on the same days and at the same time. Tap the days you can teach, or use a shortcut.

heures.titre: At what time can you start, on {jour}?
heures.explication: Choose all the times at which you can start a class. The end of the class is calculated for you.
heures.suite: You will then say whether it is the same on the other days.

memes.titre: Are these the same times for all these days?
memes.explication: You chose {jours}. On {premier}, you start at {heures}.

oui.description: The times for {premier} also apply to {autres}.
oui.explication: You can change a day before sending your application.
oui.exemple: you can start at 6 pm on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

non.description: You set the times for each day, one after the other.
non.explication: The times already chosen stay: you adjust them.
non.exemple: you start at 6 pm on Monday, but at 8 pm on Wednesday.

parJour.titre: Set the times, day by day
parJour.explication: Each day starts from the times already chosen. Add or remove times where it is not the same.

semaine.explication: Here is when you can teach, in your local time. Review it, then continue.

classesSouhaitees.titre: How many classes do you want to hold?
classesSouhaitees.explication: A class is a group of students who meet three times a week, on the same days and at the same time, with the same teacher. It is a wish: the academy decides which classes it assigns to you.

debutPossible.explication: This date helps the management know when to offer you a class.

immediat.description: You can start as soon as a class is assigned to you.
immediat.exemple: no commitment holds you back this month.

mois_prochain.description: You will be available from next month.
mois_prochain.exemple: you finish another job at the end of this month.

sous_3_mois.description: You will be available within the next three months.
sous_3_mois.exemple: you are travelling or sitting exams for a few weeks.

inconnu.description: You do not yet know your start date.
inconnu.explication: You can tell the management during the interview.
inconnu.exemple: your schedule depends on an answer you are still waiting for.

publics.explication: Choose the age groups you are comfortable teaching. There is no wrong answer: you can choose just one, or several.

o_6_9.description: They start with Rewayah's reading book, letter by letter, up to the shadda. Then come the first short surahs, the words of the prayer and the ablutions.
o_6_9.explication: Classes of 5 children at most (4 for beginners), three one-hour sessions per week. The ablutions and the prayer are shown in practice, with illustrations.
o_6_9.exemple: a class of eight-year-olds, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

o_10_13.description: Same start with the reading book, and Al-Fatiha from the first week, because at this age the child must pray.
o_10_13.explication: Classes of 5 children at most (4 for beginners), three one-hour sessions per week.
o_10_13.exemple: a class of twelve-year-olds, three times a week.

o_14_17.description: The same content as for ages 10 to 13: the reading book, and Al-Fatiha from the first week.
o_14_17.explication: Classes of 5 teenagers at most (4 for beginners), three one-hour sessions per week.
o_14_17.exemple: a class of sixteen-year-olds, three times a week.

adultes.description: Adults first learn to read with Rewayah's book. After the basics, the student chooses to read the whole Quran or to memorise it, on the teacher's advice.
adultes.explication: Classes of 6 adults at most (4 for beginners), three sessions of an hour and a half per week. Adult classes are separate: women with women, men with men.
adultes.exemple: a women's class, or a men's class, three times a week.

paysResidence.titre: Which country do you live in?
paysResidence.explication: Choose the country where you live today.

paysVersement.titre: In which country do you want to receive your pay?
paysVersement.explication: The academy checks, country by country, which payment method is possible. We carried over your country of residence: change it if needed.

compteBancaire.titre: Do you have a bank account to receive your payment, in your name or a relative's?
compteBancaire.explication: Pay is paid by bank transfer where the academy has confirmed it. Your details are only requested before the first payment.

oui.libelle: Yes, in my name or a relative's
oui.description: An account at a bank, in your name or a relative's.
oui.explication: Bank transfer can be your payment method, if the academy has confirmed it in your country.
oui.exemple: an account opened at a bank, in your brother's name.

non.description: Neither in your name, nor in a relative's.
non.explication: You can then choose a mobile payment method, if there is one in your country.
non.exemple: you only receive and send money with your phone.

operateurs.titre: Which mobile payment methods do you use?
operateurs.explication: Here are the methods the academy has confirmed in your country. Choose those you use, if any.

moyensAccessibles.titre: Which payment methods are common where you live?
moyensAccessibles.explication: Here are the methods the academy knows. Choose those that are common in your country, if any.

classes.heuresEnfants: That is {heures} per week with children.
classes.heuresAdultes: That is {heures} per week with adults.
classes.heuresLesDeux: That is {enfants} per week with children, or {adultes} with adults.
classes.explication: Each class has its own schedule, which it keeps every week.
classes.exemple1: on Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 6 pm.
classes.exemple2: on Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 6 pm, then on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday at 7 pm.

exemplePlusieurs(param=n).one: {n} class, with its days and its time.
exemplePlusieurs(param=n).other: {n} classes, each with its days and its time.

moyens.explication: Choose it if it is common where you live.
moyens.nonElimine: This question is optional and eliminates no one: your application does not depend on your answer. It helps the academy know the methods used where you live.

parcours.choisirHeure: Choose at least one start time to continue.
parcours.choisirHeureJour: Choose at least one start time for {jour}.

parcours.intro: A few questions to personalise your journey. You will then only see the schedules and options that fit your situation.
parcours.erreur: This answer could not be saved. Try again.
parcours.indisponibleTitre: The questionnaire is not available yet
parcours.indisponibleDetail: The academy has not opened this step yet. You have nothing to do for now: nothing is lost, and you can fill it in as soon as it opens.
parcours.horsLigneTitre: The journey could not be loaded
parcours.horsLigneDetail: You can try again when the connection is back. Your answers are saved.

parcours.erreurChargementDetail: An error occurred on our side. Try again in a moment; your answers are saved.
parcours.introuvableTitre: This student profile cannot be found
parcours.introuvableDetail: It may have been removed from the household. Go back to the Household to choose a student profile.
parcours.finDetail: This time slot is noted as your preference. It does not reserve a place yet.
parcours.finAjouterDetail: Does someone else in the household want to learn?
parcours.ageRaison: Age decides the length of sessions and the number of students per class. We do not ask for a date of birth: age in years is enough.
parcours.ageAide: Choose the age in years from the list, as when adding the profile.
parcours.ageSansTranche: No class is planned for this age for now. The academy team can guide you.
parcours.langueQuestion: In which language should the class be taught?
parcours.langueRaison: This is the language the teacher will speak during the session. It is independent of the app language, which you can change at any time in your settings.
parcours.lieuRaison: We only use it to show you schedules in your local time. We never ask for your exact location, and this answer does not leave your file.
parcours.niveauRaison: Your answer guides the first suggestions. It does not set the official level: the academy assigns it after a conversation with a teacher.
parcours.niveauLettresAvecAide: Letters are recognised, reading needs help
parcours.niveauLectureCourante: The Quran is already read fluently
parcours.niveauMemorisationPartielle: Part of it is already memorised
parcours.objectifRaison: You can change your goal later: it guides the teacher's work, it does not commit you.
parcours.momentsQuestion: Which times of day suit you best?
parcours.momentsRaison: This answer creates no schedule and reserves nothing. It is only used to highlight, among the schedules the academy already offers, those that suit you best. You will see all the others just below.
parcours.offresQuestion: Here are the open schedules for {prenom}
parcours.offresRaison: These schedules are shown in your local time. Choosing a schedule saves your preference: it does not reserve a place and is not yet a class.
parcours.aucuneOffreDetail: The academy opens new schedules as sign-ups come in. You can tell us what you need: it helps us decide which ones to open.
parcours.refusAucun: None of these schedules suits me
parcours.refusPrevenir: Let me know if new schedules open
parcours.refusEffet: We record that the request exists. This does not create a class, does not look for a teacher and does not promise any future schedule.
parcours.refusEnregistre: Noted. We will let you know if a matching schedule opens.
parcours.etatAPersonnaliserDetail: A few questions, and we will only show what suits {prenom}.
parcours.etatHoraireAChoisirDetail: The open schedules for {prenom} are waiting for you.
parcours.etatOffreIndisponible: This schedule is no longer offered
parcours.etatOffreIndisponibleDetail: The schedule chosen for {prenom} was withdrawn before a class was formed. Choose another: nothing is lost.
parcours.etatDiagnosticRequisDetail: One conversation with a teacher remains to place {dePrenom}'s level. The academy will offer you an appointment.
parcours.etatDiagnosticEnAttenteDetail: A conversation is planned to place {dePrenom}'s level.
parcours.etatClasseEnFormationDetailSansMinimum: A class starts once there are enough students. We will let you know as soon as it is confirmed.
parcours.etatClasseConfirmeeDetail: {dePrenom}'s class is formed. You will find its sessions in their space.
parcours.fuseauChange: Your location has changed since this choice
parcours.fuseauChangeDetail: The schedule is the same for the academy, but it no longer falls at the same time for you. Check that it still suits you.
